integrity: The uniform face classification and two-stage elementary collapse are proved mathematically for all n>=7. Independent full finite enumeration checks 7<=n<=18 and the complete n=6 boundary, but does not replace the all-n proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one distance-two chord on C_n with n>=6, and no equivariance or arbitrary-chord statement. Known B_3(C_n) sphere type is credited to prior literature. Reproducible checks do not establish independent external certification.
title: A sharp simple-homotopy stability threshold for triangle-chorded cycles
